title: Release-targeted ecosystem profiles referenced retired scenario paths

failing_environment.observed: The fresh development-breadth campaign completed 133 exact rows, then runtime.ecosystem failed before Factorio execution because release-targeted-2.1.json named fixtures/compat-matrix/local-library-scenarios.json after that authority had moved to validation/scenarios/local-2.1.json.

reproduction.observed: The release gate exited in 0.582 seconds with an exact missing-file error. The canonical 2.1 and 2.0 scenario manifests were present, and the repository path catalog and fixture manifest already named their validation/scenarios locations.

root_cause.summary: The validation-definition migrator replaced forward slashes and single backslashes but did not recognize JSON-escaped double backslashes. Four active run profiles therefore retained retired paths. Scenario-manifest validation checked the canonical manifests but did not require each run profile to bind an existing canonical scenario authority.

repair_changes: bind all 2.1 and 2.0 run profiles to validation/scenarios/local-<line>.json
teach the definition migrator to rewrite JSON-escaped path separators
regress JSON-escaped migration detection, rewrite, and idempotence
require every governed run profile to bind an existing canonical scenario manifest
bind the layout test fingerprint to the maintenance tools it executes
classify maintenance-tool changes explicitly in the impact authority
select runtime.ecosystem whenever a governed ecosystem profile or local scenario authority changes
regression_propositions: release-targeted 2.1 resolves validation/scenarios/local-2.1.json before ecosystem execution
JSON-escaped retired scenario paths are detected and rewritten canonically
a second migration preview is idempotent
a missing or noncanonical run-profile scenario authority fails static admission
ecosystem profile changes materialize runtime.ecosystem in targeted verification plans
the exact development package archive and normalized content identities remain unchanged

closure.required: focused static admission, exact runtime.ecosystem pass, unchanged deterministic package identity, latest-head hosted gate, merge to dev, and fresh source-bound breadth closure
closure.boundary: This repair changes release tooling and validation references only. It does not assign C32, advance 3.2.5 beyond planned, create 2.5.5 authority, admit 3.3, or modify published distribution authority.
